select b.PROD_NAME as prodName,/** 产品名称**/ b.PROD_ID as prodId,/** 产品代码**/ DATE_FORMAT(i.VALUE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as endDate, /** 净值日期*/ i.UNIT_VALUE as prodValue, /** 单位净值*/ i.UNIT_VALUE_T as unitValueTotal, /** 累计净值**/ b.CUSTOMER_TYPE as customerType,/** 客户类型**/ '-' as netAssetValue/** 资产净值*/ from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO b inner join REP_PROD_INDEX i on i.PROD_ID = b.PROD_ID left join REP_REVEAL l on l.REP_ID = #{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and l.`STATUS` = 'E' and l.PRODID = b.PROD_ID and DATE_FORMAT(i.VALUE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(l.END_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') and b.PRODTYPE = 'N' where b.`STATUS` = 'E'
and b.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (DATE_FORMAT(i.VALUE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') between DATE_FORMAT('1970-01-01','%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d'))
and ifnull(l.CONFIRM_STATUS, '0') = '0' /** 未确认的数据**/
